implemented: The daily deep feature library attaches metadata to every generated non-date column.
Predictors, liquidity context, and future outcome labels are distinguished; labels become available only after their future horizon matures.
Construction lookbacks, source-availability policy, and refresh cadence are explicit.
Economic holding horizons and predictive half-lives are explicitly unestimated rather than inferred from lookback windows.
Metadata rows are content-addressed; regression tests ensure complete coverage of generated columns.

tests.result: Combined feature-library and strategy-inventory suite: 9 passed; Ruff and mypy passed. Source inventory --check passes (563 Python files).

limitations: No empirical signal half-life or economic holding horizon is claimed.
Metadata does not yet cover non-price fundamentals, filings, macro, options, or every legacy feature surface.
Availability semantics still depend on each provider's actual source timestamps and rights.
